title: Cover letter for a named role
when_to_use: A letter sent with an application, read by the hiring manager of one role.
facts_hint: paste the job description, the company facts and the CV the letter goes with

personas.description: Hiring manager who reads the letter after the CV and decides whether the candidate understood the role.

dimensions.name: Specific to the role
dimensions.question: Could this letter be sent unchanged to another company?

anchors.1: the letter would read the same for any company
anchors.3: the company is named, but nothing ties the candidate to its situation
anchors.5: the letter names a need of this team and a past result that answers it

dimensions.name: Evidence
dimensions.question: Is the candidate's main claim backed by a number or a named case?

anchors.1: the main claim is an adjective, with no number and no named case
anchors.3: the main claim names a case without a number, or a number without a case
anchors.5: the main claim carries a number and a named case, both consistent with the CV

dimensions.name: The ask
dimensions.question: Does the letter end on a concrete next step?

anchors.5: a concrete next step the reader can say yes to
